---
title: "Documentation Versions"
---

The documentation site keeps each actual release in a versioned directory.
The current release stays at the site root; older directories are historical
and unmaintained.

| Site | Path | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.11.0 | `/` | Current site |
| 0.10.0 | `/v0.10.0/` | Snapshot of the actual published 0.10.0 site |
| 0.9.0 | `/v0.9.0/` | Snapshot of the actual published 0.9.0 site |
| 0.3.0 | `/v0.3.0/` | Frozen historical site |

These paths are relative to the deployed site, so the same list works under a
repository prefix such as `/askr/`. Askr's root `askr-versions.json` is the
single version-list source:

```json
{
  "mode": "inline",
  "versions": [
    {"label": "0.11.0", "root": "/", "latest": true},
    {"label": "0.10.0", "root": "/v0.10.0/"},
    {"label": "0.9.0", "root": "/v0.9.0/"},
    {"label": "0.3.0", "root": "/v0.3.0/"}
  ]
}
```

Include the manifest in `project.resources`. Each `root` identifies a complete
version site relative to that site's deployment root. The version selector is
provided by Askr; consumers maintain their own archive directories and
manifest. The Gallery's root build helper generates metadata for its own
archived sites. It is source-repository build tooling and is not installed by
`quarto add`.

Use `href` for a fixed destination instead of a `root`. Relative and
single-slash `href` values are site-relative; absolute URLs keep their origin.
Fixed destinations do not preserve the current page path. When a selector
manifest lives inside an archive, its `root` entries are relative to that
archive's site root. The Gallery generates that archive-local metadata from
the root version list.

`inline` shows the current version beside a short title. `title` shows the
title and chevron, with the version number in the menu. Try the
[long-title specimen](versions.html?askr-version-mode=title); `longTitle` is
optional and used only in `title` mode.

An inline `<script id="askr-versions" type="application/json">` can provide
the list when a fetched manifest is unavailable. Choose one source rather than
duplicating an external manifest and inline list. This Gallery uses the
external JSON.

## Keyboard interaction

The selector is a disclosure with ordinary links, not a listbox. Tab to its
button and press Enter or Space to open it. Tab and Shift-Tab move among the
links; Enter follows one. Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the
button. Tabbing away or clicking outside closes it without moving focus back.
The current version link has `aria-current="true"`.

## Archived sites

The 0.10.0 snapshot preserves the actual published Pages site before the root
moved to 0.11.0. The 0.9.0 snapshot also comes from the actual published site;
the 0.3.0 snapshot remains unchanged. These archives are historical
documentation, not maintained copies of the current Usage guide.

The current 0.11.0 selector preserves the page path, query and fragment when
switching to another version. For an ordinary same-origin click, it checks the
destination; a 404 opens the selected site's homepage. A network error retains
the original destination. Modified clicks (Cmd/Ctrl-click or a new tab) and
external URLs keep normal browser behavior, so the host's error page owns
those cases.

The 0.10.0 and 0.9.0 manifests each have a single archive-local `root` for the
current-version marker; all version links open their configured homepages. The
frozen 0.3.0 manifest uses origin-root paths and fixed links so navigation
works under `/askr/`. This Gallery's build helper generates archive manifests
from the root list without rewriting old HTML.

This page is absent from the 0.3.0 snapshot. Selecting that version opens its
homepage rather than a missing page.

## Publishing a new version

Before replacing the current site root, preserve the actual published site
under its release path. For example, the next release should first archive
0.11.0 as `/v0.11.0/`; only then should the root manifest name the new current
release and retain the older entries. Do not add a second 0.11.0 entry while
that release is still current. Consumers own this publishing step for their
own sites; the Gallery helper only prepares this repository's archive metadata.

The Gallery's long-title specimen is available at
[`versions.html?askr-version-mode=title`](versions.html?askr-version-mode=title).
Its `longTitle` manifest field is optional and does not affect version routing.
